en: Black‑and‑white historic street scene looking down a broad cobblestone avenue lined with 3–4 story townhouses and shops on both sides. People in early 20th‑century European clothing walk along the street and sidewalks; a few women wear long dresses and hats, some men wear bowler hats. On the left, a large building with mansard-style roof dominates the corner; on the right is a low retaining wall and then more buildings. In the distance the street continues straight ahead, with a line of trees forming a park or promenade on the right. A flag flies atop one of the left-side buildings.
